name: apex-drift
description: Apex Drift - a 3D online multiplayer racing game with an authoritative WebSocket server and public rooms.

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.play: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json && tsc -p client/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
